mapper.insert: insert into dishes(type_id, name, price, image, del_flag, create_by, remark, create_time) values (#{typeId}, #{name}, #{price}, #{image}, 0, #{createBy}, #{remark}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select * from dishes where id = #{id} and del_flag = 0
select * from dishes where type_id = #{typeId} and del_flag = 0

select * from dishes where del_flag = 0 and id in
#{id}

select d.*, dt.name as type_name from dishes d left join dishes_type dt on d.type_id = dt.id where d.del_flag = 0
and d.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and d.type_id = #{typeId}
order by d.create_time desc

select d.*, dt.name as type_name from set_dishes sd left join dishes d on sd.dishes_id = d.id left join dishes_type dt on d.type_id = dt.id where sd.set_id = #{setId} and d.del_flag = 0 order by sd.id
